title: RelayShield Security Tools (MCP) input
description: This Actor takes no run-time input. It's a Standby-mode MCP server -- configuration (RELAYSHIELD_API_URL/API_KEY/X_PAYMENT) is set once as Actor environment variables in Console, and per-call credentials (rs_api_key / x_payment) are supplied by each calling agent as MCP tool-call arguments, not as Actor input.
